summary: The Charles Schwab Corporation filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a public offering of 1,500,000 depositary shares, each representing a 1/100th interest in a share of 6.100% Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series L, with a liquidation preference of $100,000 per share (equivalent to $1,000 per depositary share). The offering is an ordinary equity-linked capital raise, not a special situation. Terms include a fixed dividend rate for the first five years, then reset based on the five-year Treasury rate plus 2.250%, with optional redemption by the issuer on or after June 1, 2031. Use of proceeds is to be used for general corporate purposes. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The securities are not listed on any exchange. There is no special-situation angle; this is a routine shelf takedown.
